claims.text: Clusters were extracted using k-means clustering on word embeddings, initialized with 'k-means++' and run for 300 iterations.
The clustering process involved repeating the experiment with different seed initializations to minimize cluster inertia.
The final vocabulary size used for clustering was around 1.6 million words, incorporating both in-domain and out-of-domain data.
